capability: Bounded content identification, not file validation or decoder support
integration: Pinned registry libraries through their safe slice API. No source copied, libmagic FFI, file(1) process, ambient file/mmap reader, external rules installation or filename hint.

dependencies.licence: BSD-2-Clause OR GPL-3.0, BSD-2-Clause selected for this dependency
reviewed: src/lib.rs (database, verification, matching and fallback paths)
src/readers.rs (slice versus ambient file entry points)

dependencies.licence: BSD-2-Clause OR GPL-3.0, BSD-2-Clause selected for this dependency
dependencies.database: All precompiled rules provided by this pinned crate; its documented DER exclusion remains. This is not a promise of every libmagic feature or format.

bounds.initialization: One verified immutable embedded database per process; initialization failures cached visibly. PNG sentinel verifies peer rule/MIME dispatch. No user-supplied database is deserialized.
bounds.capability_reads: At most the first 64KiB, exact partial-read loop; zero-before-prefix, overreported reads and changing source length fail. Tail reads are not attempted.
bounds.unknown: Generic data/text/empty fallbacks return None. Truncating a large input is reported separately from unexpected capability EOF.
bounds.scheduling: Synchronous CPU primitive intended for shared resource/boot workers; owner publishes the owned result.
bounds.limitations: Prefix evidence cannot authenticate a resource, detect arbitrary same-size mutation, establish complete structural validity, or prove decoder/VM support.

unsafe_policy: This workspace crate and both direct library crates forbid unsafe code. Transitive libraries are not claimed to be universally unsafe-free. pure-magic includes safe file/mmap convenience readers, but this integration never calls them.
